name: guardrails-js
description: Tells Claude when the JavaScript it wrote is unsafe or slow, so it fixes it in the same turn. Node, React, Next, Vue, Nuxt, Angular, Svelte, NestJS, tRPC. No Python, no model calls.

network.title: Check packages online before installing
network.description: Asks osv.dev and the npm registry about a package before it installs, which catches a known vulnerable version of a package you already trust. Package names leave your machine. Offline checks keep working when this is off.

performance.title: Report performance findings
performance.description: The ones that reliably bite: sync work in a request handler, N+1 queries, unbounded fan out, lost stream backpressure, unstable list keys. They never interrupt and never fail a build. Set performance to all in .guardrails-js.json for the softer ones too.

report.title: Save a report file
report.description: Appends every finding to .claude/guardrails-js-report.md so you can read back what was flagged this session. Turn off if you would rather nothing was written to the project.

priming.title: Send rules at session start
priming.description: Gives Claude a short rule set for the stack this project actually uses, so it writes it right the first time. Costs about a thousand tokens once per session.
